commit.subject: ci: split lane and app checks
commit.body:
Split the always-on workflow into its contracted lane and app jobs.
Replace CHECK_NAME with CHECK_NAMES, enforce bidirectional closure
between that list and workflow jobs, and export the configured list
through the dispatch wrapper while refusing the legacy key.
